TITLE: THE KOREAN SCHOOL BADDIE — ONE GIRL AGAINST THE ENTIRE CLASS

DURATION: 30 seconds
STYLE: Ultra-realistic Korean action drama, cinematic school fight scene, photorealistic characters, realistic physics, dramatic lighting, high-quality choreography, 4K film quality.

SETTING AND CHARACTERS:
A realistic South Korean high school classroom during the daytime. Large windows cover one side of the classroom, allowing soft natural sunlight to enter through cream-colored curtains. Wooden student desks and chairs are arranged in rows. A green chalkboard, classroom bulletin boards, school supplies, scattered notebooks, and backpacks create an authentic Korean school environment.

The main character is a beautiful Korean high school girl with a sleek, straight black bob haircut, pale natural skin, sharp expressive eyes, and a cold, fearless expression. She wears a perfectly realistic Korean school uniform consisting of a dark navy blazer with white piping, a white collared shirt, a dark tie, a dark pleated skirt, black socks, and black school shoes.

Several Korean male students wear matching navy school uniforms. They behave like arrogant school bullies, lounging in their chairs and laughing among themselves.

IMPORTANT: Maintain the same face, hairstyle, uniform, body proportions, and character identity throughout the entire video. Every movement must be physically believable. No cartoon effects, no supernatural powers, and no exaggerated CGI.

SCENE 1 — ESTABLISHING THE CLASSROOM (0–3 SECONDS)

Begin with a cinematic wide shot of a sunlit Korean high school classroom.

The Korean girl sits quietly at her desk near the large windows. Her notebook lies open, and a pink pen rests on the wooden desk. She looks forward with a calm, serious expression.

Behind her, several male students are laughing and behaving disrespectfully. One boy leans back in his chair with an arrogant smile while his friends exchange amused looks.

The camera slowly moves toward the girl, establishing the contrast between her quiet composure and the disruptive students behind her.

Natural daylight, realistic classroom ambience, subtle curtain movement, authentic Korean school atmosphere.

SCENE 2 — THE COLD STARE (3–6 SECONDS)

Cut to a close-up of the girl's face.

She slowly raises her eyes and looks directly toward the troublesome students.

Her expression changes subtly: her eyes become sharper, her lips tighten, and her face remains completely composed.

She does not shout or display exaggerated anger. Her silence communicates confidence and intimidation.

Cut briefly to a male student smirking at her. He leans forward, believing she will not react.

Use shallow depth of field, realistic skin texture, natural eye movements, and cinematic close-up framing.

SCENE 3 — THE FIRST EXPLOSIVE MOVE (6–10 SECONDS)

Without warning, one of the male students provokes her and moves aggressively into her personal space.

The girl immediately stands up, turns toward him, and delivers a fast, precisely choreographed defensive strike.

The boy loses his balance and crashes backward into a classroom desk. His chair scrapes across the floor.

The surrounding students react with shock, jumping away from their desks.

Use a sudden handheld camera movement to emphasize the surprise. Show the impact through the student's loss of balance, the movement of the desk, and the rattling chair rather than graphic injury.

The girl remains focused and composed.

SCENE 4 — THE CLASSROOM FIGHT BEGINS (10–15 SECONDS)

Switch to a medium-wide tracking shot as another uniformed boy rushes toward the girl.

She sidesteps his attack, pivots smoothly, and uses a controlled martial-arts combination to send him stumbling into an empty desk.

Another student attempts to approach from the side.

The girl turns quickly, blocks his movement, and follows with a carefully choreographed kick that forces him backward.

Vertical 9:16, 720x1280, about 22 seconds, 24 fps. Cinematic live-action look, photorealistic.

Sakura plants both armored boots firmly, extends her right arm toward the giant.

ALL SIX FIRE SIMULTANEOUSLY.
Six separate straight crimson plasma beams erupt from six physical muzzle centers, travel along their exact barrel axes and converge on the distant monster's torso.
MASSIVE SPHERICAL CRIMSON ELECTRICAL DETONATION!
The giant disintegrates inside the expanding energy sphere.
00:09–00:10 — CRIMSON SHOCKWAVE
EXTREME LONG TELEPHOTO FLASH CUT: colossal crimson energy sphere expanding between distant skyscrapers.
CUT BACK TO LOW REAR THREE-QUARTER.
The returning shockwave races down the avenue.
WHOOOOOOM!
Sakura braces against the pressure. Her silver-white ponytail whips violently, crimson fabric snaps, dust sweeps across the asphalt, parked cars shake and nearby glass vibrates.
All SIX floating weapons remain visible, adjusting propulsion against the shockwave.
Sakura stands unshaken as the distant crimson detonation fades.
CUT MID-MOVEMENT.
SIX-WEAPON AUTONOMY / PLASMA LOCK
Exactly SIX independent mechanical weapons throughout. Each possesses one physical body, one forward-facing muzzle, one propulsion system and independent targeting.
Every weapon physically rotates toward its target BEFORE firing.
MUZZLE CENTER → BARREL AXIS → STRAIGHT CRIMSON PLASMA BEAM → VISIBLE TARGET IMPACT.
Every shot has a visible source, trajectory and contact. No disconnected lasers, sideways emission, bending beams, random electrical attacks, duplicate weapons, merging cannons or disappearing units.
During synchronized firing, SIX visible muzzles produce SIX corresponding straight beams converging only at the distant target.
Weapons perform tactical interception, flank defense, repositioning and coordinated attacks. No decorative orbiting or random spinning.
PHYSICAL COMBAT / CAMERA
Realistic human anatomy, physical armor weight, knee compression, foot placement, hip rotation, shoulder stabilization and believable momentum.
Sakura remains actively engaged in combat, not standing motionless while weapons fight.
Close aerial transformation tracking, low-angle impact, rapid mechanical deployment close-ups, dynamic close-to-medium combat tracking, reactive camera swings, readable plasma impacts, low-angle synchronized firing and distant telephoto detonation.
Fast Hollywood action editing with clear spatial continuity. Natural handheld imperfections, realistic motion blur, subtle focus corrections and physically reactive camera movement.
No excessive overhead distance, impossible floating camera or uncontrolled shaking.
PHOTOREALISM / VFX
REAL HOLLYWOOD LIVE-ACTION PHOTOGRAPHY. Real metallic thickness, surface imperfections, accurate reflections, natural contact shadows, intricate mechanical articulation, realistic propulsion distortion and atmospheric depth.
Crimson plasma illuminates armor, dust and smoke with physically coherent light. Monsters possess convincing mass, muscle movement and environmental interaction.
Neutral-cool daylight. No plastic armor, synthetic humans, videogame CGI, artificial HDR, excessive saturation or yellow grading.
AUDIO — DIEGETIC ONLY
Violent free-fall wind, rapid mechanical nano-assembly, armor locking, heavy asphalt impact, propulsion turbines, monster roars, crimson plasma charging, sharp electrical discharges, synchronized energy barrage, massive distant detonation and delayed atmospheric shockwave.
NO MUSIC. NO DIALOGUE. NO NARRATION.

No anime, cartoon, illustration, videogame render, generic mecha, armor redesign, identity drift, face drift, hairstyle drift, silver-white human hair, white-gold clothing, hakama, bare arms, bare legs, shorts, skirt, clothing drift, incorrect helmet, duplicate Sakura, extra weapons, missing weapons, instant transformation, weapon clipping, random floating components, misaligned lasers, bent beams, detached muzzle emissions, random explosions, passive enemies, stationary protagonist, meaningless orbiting, repetitive movement loops, teleportation, afterimages, impossible anatomy, mannequin poses, rigid hair, frozen fabric, excessive motion smear, fake HDR, yellow color grading, blood, gore, subtitles, watermark or logos.

Use the input female portrait to lock the model identity: long straight chestnut-brown hair, natural side part, brown eyes, defined eyebrows, delicate facial features, softly defined jawline, warm natural skin tone, calm restrained performance-ad presence. Use the input product image to lock the garment: Quechua bright orange waterproof technical jacket, sculptural orange hood with black lining, central black waterproof zipper, two vertical black zippered chest pockets, long sleeves, adjustable cuffs, technical panel construction, realistic waterproof fabric texture, authentic Quechua branding. The model wears dark hiking trousers, practical hiking boots, and a compact outdoor backpack. All visible text must be English only, and the only visible brand is Quechua.

The film is a 30-second outdoor adventure commercial. The image language is natural, cinematic, and expensive, but the music must feel dynamic: uplifting electronic rhythm, around 124–132 BPM, with deep bass drums, fast electronic hi-hats, short metallic hits, synth pulses, wind, bridge creaks, rain texture, zipper sounds, and foot-splash impacts forming the rhythm. Every hard cut, foot landing, bridge movement, zipper pull, water drop impact, and head turn must land precisely on a drum hit or musical accent. The music is not background atmosphere; it is the main engine of the edit.

0–2s: lush Amazon rainforest valley in natural morning light, with green canopy, atmospheric mist, and an old suspension bridge crossing above a flowing river. Double composition: a small full-body model stands on the left wearing the orange Quechua jacket, dark hiking trousers, and hiking boots; a large frontal half-body portrait dominates the right side, hood down, central zipper and chest pockets clearly visible. The model looks toward the opposite side of the bridge, with only a subtle forward movement around 1s, while the music enters with low-frequency pulses and fast electronic rhythm.

2–4.5s: a heavy drum hit cuts hard into a suspension-bridge crossing shot. Frontal half-body close-up as the model walks across the bridge, rainforest and river visible behind her. Wind moves surrounding leaves and her hair. Storm clouds gather over the canopy as the first raindrops strike her shoulders. Natural light illuminates her face, orange hood, and water beads on the jacket. Each rain impact follows the fast electronic hi-hat texture.

4.5–6.5s: top-down tracking shot of the model crossing wet wooden bridge planks. The river is visible between the boards. The camera stays close above her body, showing the orange jacket, swinging arms, dark hiking trousers, boots, and splashing water. She accelerates toward the opposite bank as rainfall intensifies. Each foot landing bursts water outward and triggers a short metallic accent.

6.5–9s: stay in the real rainforest environment. Water beads sit on the orange waterproof fabric and slide along seams; the central zipper, black chest pockets, hood, and cuffs flash through natural light. The model raises the hood, tightens its adjustment, and closes the zipper while continuing across the bridge, each action landing on a clear metallic beat and synth pulse.

9–12s: rainforest side-running wide shot. Use diffused natural light filtering through the canopy, wrapping around the body and rain haze. The model runs left to right toward the opposite bank; hiking boots, wet ground reflections, tropical leaves, and drifting mist flash briefly. The suspension bridge recedes behind her as she enters the jungle trail. The music moves into denser drums, and the image cuts follow her running cadence.

12–16s: rain portrait close-up. Three-quarter side face, hood up, long chestnut-brown hair moving naturally in the wind. Rain covers the orange hood and shoulders. Her facial features remain consistent with the reference portrait. A small Quechua mark on the jacket is visible but understated. Dense water beads cover the fabric while rain lines cross the background. The model slowly turns her head toward the trail, and the end of the turn lands on a deep bass hit.

16–20s: waterproof detail climax. Extreme close-ups of orange shoulder water beads, cuffs, vertical chest pockets, central zipper, hood seams, and jacket adjustment details. Water forms round droplets and rolls off the surface; natural light travels across the fabric texture while the jacket remains matte and water-repellent. Editing becomes faster, alternating water beads, zipper, hood adjustment, and boot-splash impacts on the beat.

20–24s: keep the entire section inside the rain-soaked Amazon rainforest. Intercut foot splashes, running side silhouettes, orange fabric water beads, rain falling from tropical leaves, shoulder seams, and zipper details. The cuts move quickly between the model’s sharp side face, defocused shoulder, boot splash, and macro fabric droplets as bass drums, electronic hi-hats, and percussion become denser. She pushes through the final stretch of vegetation and emerges into a small clearing.

24–27s: main half-body hero stance. The model stands slightly right of center in the rainforest clearing, hood up, surrounded by lush green foliage and rain haze. The central zipper is vertical and clean; the two black chest pockets and orange hood are clearly visible. The music pauses for half a beat, then the low end drops back in. Small white sans-serif text appears at the side: “QUECHUA WATERPROOF JACKET”.

27–30s: final end frame. Rain-soaked rainforest background. A giant close foreground crop of the orange jacket shoulder and hood fills almost half of the left side, showing fabric texture, seam lines, water beads, and a small Quechua mark. Far on the right, the full-body model stands on the muddy trail near the suspension bridge, wearing the same orange jacket, dark hiking trousers, and hiking boots, illuminated by natural light breaking through the canopy. Final minimal text only: “QUECHUA — READY FOR THE OUTDOORS”. The music resolves with a strong low-frequency tail and rain sound, leaving clear rainforest ambience in the final second.

Create an ultra-realistic 16 9 cinematic comedy short film featuring a young American woman in her 20s attempting an absurd long-distance snack trick from a snowy Colorado mountain summit to a cozy ski resort lodge below. Use the uploaded reference image for her exact facial identity and appearance. She wears a fitted black winter outfit, gloves, and snow boots on the mountain, then a cream oversized sweater, dark jeans, and winter boots inside the lodge. Her friends wear colorful ski jackets: a red-haired woman in pink, a man in an orange jacket, a bearded man in blue, and a friend wearing a silver puffer jacket and ski goggles.

On the mountain summit, she lies dramatically on a snow-covered viewing platform, carefully lining up a harmless oversized novelty marshmallow launcher toward a giant open snack bucket displayed on the lodge patio below. She bites her lip nervously, squints through a ridiculous toy-style scope, then gives the camera a confident grin. Extreme close-up of her eye, followed by a fast whip-pan and a bright white flash.

Cut to a wide view of a beautiful Colorado ski resort, with pine forests, snowy slopes, chairlifts, and a rustic wooden lodge. A giant marshmallow sails through the crisp mountain air in exaggerated slow motion, wobbling comically toward the lodge.

Inside the lodge café, her friends sit at a wooden counter with steaming mugs of hot chocolate. The marshmallow bounces harmlessly off the exterior window and lands directly in an open bowl of mini marshmallows on the patio table. Everyone looks outside in confusion.

Cut to the woman inside the café, now wearing her cream sweater, sitting innocently with her mouth open as if she expected the snack to arrive. Her friends exchange suspicious looks.

Suddenly, the lodge's outdoor snack bucket tips slightly in the wind, and a single marshmallow rolls through the open patio doorway and lands perfectly in her mouth. She closes her eyes and chews triumphantly while everyone stares at her in disbelief.

She opens one eye, smiles, and says, “Delivery confirmed.” Her friends burst into laughter, and the final shot holds on their stunned expressions.

Create a 30-second, 1080p ultra-photorealistic live-action zombie-horror video aboard a luxury sleeper train traveling through a modern city during a sudden zombie outbreak.

MAIN SETTING: A realistic luxury train cabin with cream-colored bedding, dark walnut panels, warm amber reading lights, and a huge panoramic window. A young adult East Asian woman with natural skin texture and slightly messy black hair sits on the bed wearing a simple cream-colored top. Beside her is an adorable, tiny, fluffy Pomeranian puppy with soft cream-and-white fur, small triangular ears, dark round eyes, and a little black nose. The puppy looks and behaves like a real young dog, with natural blinking, subtle ear movements, and gentle breathing. The woman occasionally holds the puppy close, but neither character should dominate the camera.

VISUAL PRIORITY: Approximately 80–90% of the visual attention must remain on the terrifying events outside the panoramic window. The woman and puppy are secondary foreground elements that establish the train's interior perspective.

0–6 SECONDS — THE FIRST SIGNS: The train moves past a busy urban railway platform beneath a grey, overcast sky. Commuters suddenly begin running in different directions. A person stumbles near a concrete pillar while a disheveled, bloodied infected person emerges from the crowd. Other commuters flee. The woman and puppy are only partially visible at the edge of the frame.

6–12 SECONDS — ZOMBIES IN THE STREETS: Through the moving window, a group of infected people with realistic practical makeup, dirty skin, torn everyday clothing, and disturbing but believable movements chase terrified pedestrians across a street beside the railway. One infected person knocks against a parked car. People abandon bags and run toward nearby buildings. The camera stays focused on the exterior action.

12–18 SECONDS — A CITY IN PANIC: The train passes a row of shops and a stationary city bus. Panicked passengers scramble out of the bus as several zombies approach. One infected person strikes a bus window, leaving a visible blood smear. Other infected figures chase civilians between parked vehicles. Buildings and concrete pillars naturally pass across the frame, briefly obscuring and revealing the chaos.

18–24 SECONDS — RUNNING BESIDE THE TRAIN: A realistic infected person emerges from behind a concrete support and runs alongside the moving train for several seconds, reaching toward the window. Its clothes flutter in the wind, and its movements have believable human weight. More infected people pursue fleeing commuters along the railway-side walkway. The camera tracks the exterior scene naturally without cutting to reaction close-ups.

24–30 SECONDS — THE OUTBREAK SPREADS: The train crosses an elevated railway bridge overlooking a large urban intersection. Abandoned vehicles block the road, smoke rises from a damaged building, and crowds of civilians flee as a mass of infected people pours through the streets. Briefly include the tiny fluffy puppy in the lower-right foreground, sitting close to the woman and looking toward the window with alert ears. Keep the exterior disaster sharply dominant. As the train passes beneath a darker concrete structure, an infected figure suddenly appears in a gap between the supports before vanishing from view. End abruptly as the train continues through the devastated city.

REALISM AND CAMERA: Professional live-action disaster-thriller cinematography, realistic 35mm lens perspective, natural overcast daylight, accurate reflections on glass, subtle train vibration, physically correct background movement, realistic motion blur, atmospheric smoke, detailed urban textures, and restrained cinematic color grading. Use a continuous viewpoint from inside the same moving train. Keep the woman, puppy, cabin layout, lighting, and train direction consistent.

PUPPY REALISM: The puppy must remain a small, fluffy, anatomically correct real dog throughout the video. Preserve its cream-and-white coat, tiny body, dark eyes, and natural proportions. Use subtle, believable movements rather than exaggerated reactions. No sudden breed changes, duplicated limbs, oversized eyes, or cartoon-like expressions.

ZOMBIE REALISM: Human-sized infected people with practical prosthetic wounds, pale or dirty skin, torn everyday clothing, and convincing physical movement. No glowing eyes, supernatural powers, fantasy monsters, or exaggerated CGI appearances.

AUDIO: Authentic train-wheel rumble, subtle cabin vibration, distant sirens, muffled screams, footsteps, vehicle impacts, and chaotic city ambience. The puppy may give one small, natural whimper as the outside noise grows louder. No dialogue, narration, subtitles, logos, or watermarks.

STRICT NEGATIVE PROMPT: No cat, no other pets, no cartoon effects, no video-game graphics, no artificial-looking CGI, no plastic skin, no exaggerated acting, no impossible camera movement, no inconsistent architecture, no teleportation, no montage, no prolonged facial close-ups, and no sudden changes in character appearance. Prioritize realistic exterior horror and a continuous, believable train journey.

Create a 15-second, 16:9 psychedelic horror music video: 30 distinct animated compositions, an average of 0.5 seconds per shot. Start at full intensity on the first frame. Make the supplied artworks come violently alive inside a corrupted, hypnotic nightmare.

REFERENCE DIRECTION
Use all supplied images as visual references. Preserve their recognizable silhouettes, intricate ornament, chrome surfaces, skulls, horns, jeweled details, printed textures, deep blacks, blood-red accents and electric rainbow colors. Develop additional compositions from these motifs to reach 30 shots. Preserve the mix of photographic detail and graphic illustration. Each shot fills the screen.
MOTION PRIORITY
The subjects themselves must move, not just the camera. Use one dominant, instantly readable action per shot:

Horned figures snap their heads toward the viewer; metallic blindfolds ripple and ribbons whip outward.
Chrome mouths open abruptly; keys twist, chains swing and skull-shaped jewelry vibrates.

Uncanny deer jerk forward; antlers branch rapidly and nearby plants coil inward.
Skeletal warriors slash across the frame; armor plates shift and radial patterns spin behind them.
A psychedelic mechanical tunnel contracts and pulls the camera through its center.
Giant cybernetic skulls loom over a neon city; jaw mechanisms snap and buildings bend around them.
Chrome bird-skull creatures thrust their beaks toward the lens; segmented necks coil and unfold.
A skeletal astronaut snaps toward camera as neon vapor pours through the helmet.
Striped cakes twist like living sculptures; cream stretches, cherries levitate and red syrup flows upward.
Horned skull idols rotate abruptly; ornaments orbit their faces and printed layers slip out of registration.
An ornate oiran-like figure turns sharply; hair ornaments vibrate, sleeves whip and metallic ribs expand.
A jeweled black cat fixes its gaze on the viewer, then lunges toward the lens as its ornaments scatter into light.
Use different actions and framing when a motif returns. Make every scene visibly animate from its first frame. Keep the main subject recognizable beneath the distortion.
EDITING / 15-SECOND STRUCTURE
0.0-3.0s: 5 shots, approximately 0.6s each. Open with an extreme close-up of a horned face snapping toward camera on the first kick. Cut through a metallic mouth, a deer, a skeletal warrior and a tunnel. Immediate impact; no intro.
3.0-6.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Neon city skulls, chrome bird creatures, astronaut and cat. Hard cuts, whip-pan transitions and sudden changes of scale.
6.0-9.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Warping desserts, horned idols and the ornate figure. Surfaces stretch, liquefy and snap back. Push through an eye, mouth or spiral into the next composition.
9.0-12.0s: 6 shots, alternating approximately 0.4s and 0.6s. Return to earlier motifs with more aggressive actions, extreme close-ups, inverted viewpoints and brief kaleidoscopic multiplication.
12.0-15.0s: 7 shots: six approximately 0.4s shots followed by a 0.6s final shot. Maximum kinetic intensity. End with a horned skull rushing into the lens, the image tearing into chromatic fragments, then an abrupt cut to black on the final distorted impact. No fade.

GLITCH / NOISE
Dense, deliberate analog and digital corruption: RGB channel separation, horizontal scanline tears, VHS tracking errors, CRT interference, granular static, datamosh trails, pixel-sorting streaks, block displacement, color inversion, frame skipping and short motion echoes. Place strong glitches on cuts, kicks and snare fills. Use brief 1-3-frame disruptions and textured noise bursts while keeping the subjects visible. Distortion must react to moving forms. Alternate crisp, disturbing detail with explosive corruption. Avoid prolonged full-screen white flashes.

CAMERA
Aggressive crash zooms, rapid lateral whip pans, short barrel rolls, macro-to-wide jumps and forward dives through openings. Choose one main camera move per shot. Preserve clear focal points and deep layered motion.
AUDIO

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE

Deep detailed shadows, delicate analog grain, halation and realistic reflections; absolutely no colors, neon or glossy CGI. Impossible law: ignored motion trails solidify into architecture; those who stop to care become sharply visible. Maintain a traceable transformation chain: stone stair edges become road lanes, traffic trails become sideways rain, umbrella ribs become banyan roots. Cradling the bird, he runs three steps along a broad solid ledge, coat swinging toward the new gravity. The entire video is recorded by a parent using a consumer MiniDV camcorder during a family vacation to Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom in summer 2001. Authentic early-2000s home-video footage, imperfect handheld framing, natural camera shake, occasional autofocus hunting, slight digital zoom, exposure adjustments, soft standard-definition detail, and interlaced-video artifacts.

The camera operator is a parent documenting the day spontaneously. The camera sometimes lags behind the action, pans too far, and takes a moment to find the subject again. Every shot must look like footage recorded by the same family on the same camcorder.

No professional tracking shots, drone footage, cinematic slow motion, modern smartphone footage, or polished commercial cinematography.

Father: Early-30s American man wearing a faded navy-blue polo shirt, beige cargo shorts, white athletic sneakers, and a black camcorder wrist strap.

Mother: Early-30s American woman wearing a pale yellow short-sleeved top, denim shorts, white sneakers, and a small shoulder bag.

Son: Eight-year-old American boy with short brown hair, wearing a red T-shirt, blue denim shorts, white socks, and white sneakers. He carries a small disposable souvenir bag.

All three characters must retain exactly the same faces, ages, hairstyles, body proportions, and clothing throughout the video.

Their behaviour is spontaneous and natural. The boy is excited, curious, and occasionally distracted. The parents smile, laugh, and speak casually. No exaggerated acting or perfectly synchronized reactions.

Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom, Florida, in summer 2001.

Recognizable locations include Main Street, U.S.A., Cinderella Castle, a classic theme-park attraction, and a daytime parade route. Period-appropriate park signage, costumes, architecture, merchandise, and crowd clothing.

The park is busy with families, strollers, paper maps, disposable cameras, and visitors carrying camcorders. The footage must not contain modern smartphones, contemporary electric vehicle designs, modern social-media references, or present-day digital advertising screens.

SHOT 01 — 00:00–00:04

Purpose: Establish the vacation and reveal the castle.

Camera: Handheld wide shot from adult eye level on Main Street, U.S.A. The camcorder initially points toward passing visitors before the operator slowly pans toward Cinderella Castle.

Purpose: Capture the child’s genuine reaction.

Camera: Slightly shaky medium close-up at the boy’s eye level. The father bends down to film him, creating a brief downward camera movement.

Action: The boy turns from the castle toward the lens with wide eyes and a huge natural smile. He points behind himself, then grabs his father’s free hand and tries to pull him forward.

Boy, excitedly:

Father, laughing:

SHOT 03 — 00:08–00:12

Purpose: Move naturally from the entrance into the attraction experience.

Camera: Handheld footage from a seated position inside a classic dark ride, resembling an early-2000s family attraction. Slightly shaky medium shot of the boy seated between his parents.

Action: The ride vehicle moves slowly forward. The boy looks from one side to the other at colourful illuminated scenery. He laughs and briefly leans toward his mother. The father turns the camcorder slightly to keep both faces in frame.

SHOT 04 — 00:12–00:17

Purpose: Show the energy of the park.

Camera: Handheld medium-wide shot from behind the family at the parade route. The father raises the camcorder above shoulder level, then adjusts the zoom.

Action: A colourful Disney parade passes along the street. Period-appropriate costumed performers wave to spectators while a decorated parade float moves slowly past. The boy waves enthusiastically from beside his mother.

Voiceover:

Audio: Parade music, clapping, children’s excited voices, and the sound of the crowd. The narration remains clear but does not drown out the real environment.

End frame: The boy is waving toward the passing parade, with his mother smiling beside him.

SHOT 05 — 00:17–00:21

Purpose: Capture an ordinary, personal vacation memory.

Camera: Handheld medium close-up outside a period-appropriate snack stand. Natural daylight, slightly uneven exposure.

Action: The mother hands the boy a Mickey-shaped frozen treat. He takes a bite, notices a little melting onto his fingers, and laughs. The father moves the camera closer, then pulls back when the boy reaches toward the lens with his sticky hand.

Mother, laughing:
“Careful! Don’t get it on the camera!”

Audio: Family laughter, paper wrapping, nearby conversations, and distant park music.

End frame: The boy grins at the camera while holding the treat carefully in both hands.

SHOT 06 — 00:21–00:26

Purpose: Transition naturally from daytime excitement to evening.

Camera: Handheld wide shot from behind the family as they walk along Main Street, U.S.A. toward Cinderella Castle.

Action: The boy walks between his parents, holding both their hands. The father briefly turns the camcorder toward the illuminated shop windows, then pans back to the family.

The sky is approaching dusk, and warm park lights begin to stand out. The transition is a chronological jump forward to later that same day, not an instantaneous change in lighting within a continuous shot.

Voiceover:
“We didn’t know which moments we’d remember. We just kept recording.”

Audio: Softer crowd chatter, footsteps, distant music, and the camcorder operator’s quiet breathing.

End frame: The family slows down with the illuminated castle in the background.

SHOT 07 — 00:26–00:30

Purpose: Deliver a nostalgic and emotionally memorable ending.

Camera: Handheld medium-wide shot, slightly tilted, with the family and castle visible. The father steadies the camcorder against his body but does not achieve perfect professional framing.

Action: The boy turns toward the camera and waves. His mother places a hand on his shoulder. The father holds the shot for a moment, then the camera slowly dips toward the pavement as if he is lowering it to stop recording.

Voiceover, warm and reflective:
“Maybe that’s why the old memories mean so much. We were there. And that was enough.”

Audio: Distant park music, gentle crowd ambience, footsteps, and natural microphone noise. No dramatic orchestral swell.

Final frame: The image tilts downward toward the pavement, briefly catching the family’s moving feet. The recording ends abruptly, like an authentic home-video tape.

LIGHTING

Natural Florida summer daylight during the daytime scenes. Warm, slightly uneven tungsten and decorative lighting in the evening. Realistic exposure shifts when moving between bright outdoor spaces and darker attractions. No cinematic rim lighting, artificial haze, or modern commercial colour grading.

HUMAN PERFORMANCE

Every character must behave like a real family on vacation. The boy reacts spontaneously, speaks casually, and changes attention naturally. The parents do not pose for the camera continuously. Background visitors walk, talk, queue, and watch the parade independently.

Avoid synchronized crowds, frozen background people, exaggerated expressions, duplicated faces, unnatural hand movements, and artificial smiles.

AUDIO

Authentic early-2000s family home-video sound. Natural family conversations, footsteps, distant music, ride sounds, crowd chatter, laughter, and subtle camcorder microphone noise.

Voiceover should sound like a warm, conversational contemporary YouTube documentary narrator reflecting on childhood memories. Keep narration separate from character dialogue. No trailer-style delivery, artificial cinematic impacts, or overpowering music.

VISUAL CHARACTER

Authentic 2001 consumer MiniDV recording. Present the footage in a 9:16 vertical canvas with the actual camcorder image framed in a 4:3 aspect ratio, preserving its original proportions without stretching faces.

Soft standard-definition resolution, mild digital noise, interlaced-video texture, occasional autofocus hunting, subtle colour bleeding, imperfect white balance, slight overexposure in bright sunlight, and naturally warm skin tones.

The result must resemble a genuine family vacation tape recovered decades later—not a modern recreation designed to look cinematic.

CONTINUITY

1. The same father, mother, and son appear throughout all seven shots.
2. Clothing, faces, hairstyles, body proportions, and accessories remain consistent.
3. The boy remains eight years old and wears the same red T-shirt and denim shorts.
4. The family moves logically through Magic Kingdom, from Main Street to an attraction, the parade route, a snack stand, and back toward the castle.
5. Daylight progresses naturally into dusk across the sequence.
6. The camcorder perspective remains that of the father recording his family.
7. Every shot begins with a clear physical position and ends with a composition that supports the next cut.
8. No teleporting, sudden wardrobe changes, duplicated family members, unexplained location changes, or contradictory movements.
9. No modern phones, social-media overlays, captions, or artificial transitions.
10. The footage must retain its candid, imperfect home-video character throughout.

FINAL INTENT

Create a believable 30-second family vacation memory from Walt Disney World’s Magic Kingdom in 2001. The viewer should feel as though they have found an old MiniDV tape documenting one ordinary but unforgettable childhood day.

The emotional power comes from spontaneous reactions, small family interactions, authentic period details, and the imperfect camera work of a parent trying to capture everything.

The final result must feel lived-in, nostalgic, intimate, and real—not a polished Disney advertisement or an AI-generated cinematic montage.

Reference image 1 = the mechanical skull ninja.

Reference image 2 = the mechanical reaper.

Abilities: transforming into black mist to teleport, violet lightning magic, and scythe attacks.

Keep their designs, proportions, weapons, and abilities distinct throughout.
Use the reference sheets only for character appearance. Do not show their panels, labels, multiple views, or studio backgrounds.
There is one ninja and one reaper.

ACTION AND CAMERA TIMELINE

0–1 SECOND
At the first frame, the ninja is already bursting outward through a high-rise facade, airborne amid exploding glass, concrete, and bent steel. Before the second ends, the ninja throws three skull-shaped shuriken toward the reaper hovering across the intersection.

1–2 SECONDS
The reaper dissolves into black mist. All three shuriken pass through and embed in three separate billboard supports surrounding the intersection. Their impacts are briefly visible, appearing to be missed attacks.
CAMERA: Wide view over the ninja's shoulder, showing the dodge and the shuriken's destinations.

2–3 SECONDS
The reaper reforms directly behind the airborne ninja and swings the huge scythe across the ninja's neck level. The ninja twists sideways, narrowly clearing the blade.
CAMERA: Fast whip-pan following the reaper's reappearance into a readable side view of the near miss.

3–4 SECONDS
The missed scythe swing shears through a billboard frame and the corner of a nearby building. Steel folds and masonry falls. The ninja plants both feet against an intact wall and launches away.
CAMERA: Low lateral tracking along the wall, with the blade's destructive path visible behind the ninja.

4–5 SECONDS
The reaper fires branching violet lightning after the ninja. The ninja races along the facade as successive lightning impacts blast windows and concrete immediately behind each footfall.
CAMERA: High-speed parallel tracking, holding the ninja's body sharp against the moving background.

5–6 SECONDS
The reaper teleports through black mist into the ninja's path and strikes the ninja's torso with the scythe shaft. A circular pressure wave erupts, launching the ninja across the street.
CAMERA: Medium side view that clearly shows contact, then rapidly widens to follow the knockback.

6–7 SECONDS
The ninja crashes into the opposite building, caving in glass and metal cladding. Without pausing, the ninja kicks off an exposed steel beam and rockets back out through the expanding debris.
CAMERA: Exterior three-quarter view, snapping backward as the ninja rebounds toward the lens.

7–8 SECONDS
The ninja delivers a high-speed, cyan-charged palm strike to the reaper's chest. The reaper is driven downward through a projecting sign and into the asphalt, creating a crater.
CAMERA: Steep overhead tracking dive following the reaper's descent and impact.

8–9 SECONDS
Black mist erupts from the crater. The reaper reforms above it, lifting the scythe as violet lightning coils around the blade. The ninja lands at the edge of the intersection.
CAMERA: Low quarter-orbit around the crater, framing both opponents and the gathering lightning.

9–10 SECONDS
The reaper unleashes a massive lightning-charged scythe slash. The ninja accelerates sideways beneath its path. The missed attack tears through another building facade in a chain of concrete explosions.
CAMERA: Wide lateral tracking that shows the ninja's escape and the slash striking the architecture.

10–11 SECONDS
While sliding to a stop, the ninja forms a sharp hand seal. The SAME three shuriken from the opening ignite with pale-cyan light. Their positions connect into a triangular sealing field enclosing the reaper.
CAMERA: Rapid crane upward, revealing all three original shuriken and the trap's geometry.
The three supporting anchor structures remain intact.

11–12 SECONDS
The reaper attempts to dissolve into black mist, but the mist strikes the cyan field and is forced back into the original solid mechanical body. The failed escape is visually unmistakable. The ninja immediately launches toward the trapped reaper.
CAMERA: Fast push toward the reaper, showing the mist rebound and the ninja approaching behind it.

12–13 SECONDS
The ninja crosses the remaining distance in one explosive burst and drives a cyan-charged fist into the reaper's mechanical chest. Show the exact contact, armor buckling, and the internal mechanism rupturing. A powerful pressure ring blows surrounding debris outward.
CAMERA: Tight three-quarter side view with a very brief impact slowdown, immediately returning to full speed.

13–14 SECONDS
The reaper's entire mechanical body shatters into hundreds of metal fragments, brass gears, broken armor plates, wires, and torn cloth. The enormous scythe snaps apart and its clock assembly breaks free. The black mist dissipates completely.
CAMERA: Rapid pullback revealing the full mechanical destruction, without hiding it behind smoke or a white flash.

14–15 SECONDS
The ninja lands in a low stance in the foreground while the reaper's scrap rains onto the street behind. The broken clock assembly falls into the foreground and strikes the asphalt with one distinct metallic clack.
CAMERA: Ground-level tracking that settles on the ninja and the falling clock component.
End with the ninja clearly victorious and the reaper completely destroyed.

SOUND DESIGN
Synchronize rushing air, shuriken whistles, tearing steel, cascading glass, concrete impacts, thunder cracks, electrical discharge, scythe movement, mechanical strain, and falling scrap.
Give black-mist teleportation a short suction-like sound.
Give the sealing field a rising resonant hum.
Emphasize the final chest impact and the last clock component striking the pavement.
No dialogue or narration. The action and reversal must also be understandable without sound.

CONSTRAINTS
No introductory pose, stare-down, or title card.
No character duplication, identity swaps, costume changes, or weapon merging.
Only the reaper uses black mist and lightning.
The ninja's speed is physical movement, not black-mist teleportation.
Preserve accumulated environmental damage and the three opening shuriken until the trap activates.
No blood, flesh, or organic gore: the defeated reaper breaks apart as machinery.
No regeneration or surviving reaper silhouette.
Avoid constant slow motion, excessive camera spinning, unreadable motion blur, and effects that conceal decisive impacts.
No added subtitles, captions, watermarks, or reference-sheet text.

まな板の真上からの俯瞰ショット。包丁が素早く動き、ニンニクを細かく刻む。手元の動きを鮮明に捉える。

コンロのつまみを操作する手元の接写。次の瞬間、青い炎が勢いよく点火する。
④ 肉を焼く
熱したフライパンに厚切り和牛を投入。肉の表面を超接写。美しい焼き色がつき、脂がじゅわっと浮かび上がる。食欲をそそるリアルな質感。

トングで肉を豪快に裏返す。表面に広がる美しい焼き目を見せる。肉汁と脂が弾ける瞬間を迫力ある接写で捉える。

焼き上がったステーキをナイフでカット。美しいミディアムレアの断面と、あふれる肉汁を超接写で見せる。
⑦ ソースをかける
フライドポテト、ボイルしたニンジン、サラダが美しく盛り付けられた高級白磁のプレート。そこへステーキを載せ、濃厚なデミグラスソースを丁寧にかける。

完成した料理をカウンターに置く。置いた直後、画面端から別の人物の手が素早くカットインし、皿を持ち去る。料理が提供される瞬間を一瞬だけ見せる。
料理は高級ホテルのフレンチレストランで提供されるような極上のメインディッシュ。肉の焼き色、断面、ソースの艶、付け合わせの彩りを美しく描写する。

■ 11〜15秒：オチ・組織の監視
場面は客席へ切り替わる。
客はすでに指定のテーブルに着席しており、目の前には完成した豪華なステーキプレートが置かれている。すぐ横にはフロアメイドが立っている。

その様子を映したところで映像終了。

The helicopter rapidly loses stability and descends toward the industrial ruins as ground workers look on in alarm. Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, Ukrainian SSR, Soviet Union — autumn 1986. Ground workers instinctively move away from the falling helicopter. Rotor fragments and dust scatter through the air as the aircraft drops beside the reactor complex.

12.5–15 — THE DESCENT
The helicopter drops rapidly toward the ground, its fuselage tilted and rotor system severely damaged. Ground workers look upward and run for cover. Smoke rolls across the frame as the aircraft descends beyond the edge of a concrete structure. The engine sound becomes unstable.

ART DIRECTION: Sophisticated Japanese street photography. Balanced compositions, restrained visual clutter, crisp natural detail, subtle film grain, selective colorful accents, and beautiful late-afternoon light. Authentic Osaka youth culture and contemporary storefronts.

CHARACTER PERSONALITY & PERFORMANCE

The protagonist is a beautiful, worldly young Japanese woman with quiet feminine confidence, grace, and natural warmth. Comfortable with her beauty without vanity, she is charming, socially perceptive, and genuinely interested in others.

BODY LANGUAGE: Relaxed shoulders, elegant posture, fluid walking, natural gestures, and unhurried confidence. Never stiff, mechanical, or exaggerated.

EXPRESSIONS: Emotionally responsive eyes, subtle facial changes, genuine curiosity, and spontaneous smiles. She listens attentively and reacts naturally rather than maintaining a fixed expression.

SOCIAL CONNECTION: Her laughter comes from real moments of amusement. She makes warm eye contact, responds to others' expressions, and shares genuine, relatable human connections.

AVOID: Automatic smiles, blank stares, rehearsed reactions, exaggerated posing, theatrical laughter, robotic dialogue, or emotionally disconnected performances.

SCENE 01 | 0:00–0:04 | Osaka Arrival

The reference frame comes alive. The protagonist walks toward the camera along a lively Amerikamura pedestrian sidewalk, moving with relaxed, graceful confidence.

OPENING LOCATION TITLE: Display exactly:
Osaka, Japan

Centered horizontally and vertically in the frame. Large white Poppins Semi-Bold inside a compact semi-transparent charcoal-gray rounded rectangle (#17212B, approximately 60% opacity). Soft rounded corners, balanced internal padding, no decorative elements.

Visible for the first three seconds only. No neighborhood name, second line, or additional text.

A handsome young Japanese male acquaintance with contemporary, fashionably textured spiky hair approaches from the opposite direction. His styling reflects current Japanese youth fashion. He is gorgeous with model-like features.

He recognizes her and smiles.

Friend: "Hey, long time no see!"

She turns toward him with genuine recognition, her eyes brightening. She smiles warmly and gives a small wave while continuing forward.

One continuous tracking shot with a brief reaction angle. Hard cut.

SCENE 02 | 0:04–0:09 | Y2K Fashion Boutique

Hard cut inside a contemporary Osaka Y2K women's fashion boutique.

STORE DESIGN: Bright, stylish retail interior with cream and pale-gray architectural surfaces, selective pink and soft cyan LED lighting, chrome fixtures, and organized racks displaying colorful Y2K fashion. Pastel garments, metallic fabrics, and graphic pieces provide visual interest without clutter.

Natural white lighting keeps skin tones accurate. The store feels youthful, fashionable, and inviting.
A friendly, pretty young Japanese saleswoman faces the protagonist.

She holds up a fitted, sleeveless pastel-pink and turquoise Y2K women's top with an asymmetrical neckline and subtle metallic detailing.

GARMENT ORIENTATION: The top faces forward, showing its front neckline and design. The saleswoman holds it naturally by the shoulders at chest height. Never backward.

Saleswoman: "I think this would look amazing on you!"

The protagonist studies the top, tilts her head slightly, and gives the saleswoman an amused, skeptical smile.

Her smile grows into genuine laughter. Both women share the moment naturally.

CAMERA: Attractive medium two-shot followed by one brief reaction angle. Keep both women and the colorful boutique visible. No garment close-ups, clothing-rack inserts, or excessive cuts.

SCENE 03 | 0:09–0:19 | Are You That Guy?

Hard cut to a lively Amerikamura pedestrian sidewalk.

A friendly young Japanese street photographer in contemporary casual streetwear approaches carrying a compact digital camera.

He smiles politely, stopping at a respectful distance.

Photographer: "You're beautiful. Can I take your photo?"

She stops and gives him her attention. Her expression shifts from curiosity to amused recognition as she realizes he might be one of the social-media street photographers she's seen online.
Protagonist: "Wait, are you the guy who takes photos of people and posts them on social media?"
Her delivery is playful and curious, with a little laughter in her voice.

He smiles and nods.

Photographer: "That's me!"

She laughs softly, briefly glances down, then looks back at him and agrees with a small nod.

PHOTOGRAPH SEQUENCE:

The photographer raises his compact digital camera.

She naturally shifts her weight onto one leg, gently adjusts a loose strand of hair, and settles into an effortless, confident pose.

She looks directly into the photographer's camera lens, eyes fully open, with a beautiful, warm, confident, feminine smile. Her expression is natural, radiant, and approachable.

He takes ONE photograph. One crisp shutter click.

PHOTO FREEZE-FRAME: At the shutter click, cut directly to the resulting photograph and hold it perfectly still for approximately ONE SECOND. Sharp, beautifully composed portrait of her looking straight into the lens, eyes open, with the same warm, confident smile. Natural skin texture, beautiful lighting, no artificial beauty effects.

After the one-second photographic hold, hard cut to the next scene.

STRICT SHOT LIMIT: One camera-raising shot, one photograph, one-second photographic freeze-frame. No repeated poses, multiple shutter sequences, extended modeling, or unnecessary portrait inserts.

PERFORMANCE: Curiosity → recognition → playful amusement → relaxed confidence. Genuine conversational rhythm, subtle laughter, and natural emotional transitions. No exaggerated surprise or influencer-style performance.

SCENE 04 | 0:19–0:25 | Takoyaki Vendor

Hard cut to a small, authentic Osaka takoyaki street-food stall.

A friendly Japanese vendor hands the protagonist six freshly prepared takoyaki in a shallow, rectangular natural wood-grain takeaway boat tray with raised edges, supported underneath by a folded white paper sleeve.

The golden-brown takoyaki are topped with dark sauce, Japanese mayonnaise, aonori, and delicate bonito flakes. A short bamboo pick rests in the tray.

She accepts the food with an appreciative smile and takes a small bite using the pick.

The filling is unexpectedly hot.

Protagonist: "Hot!"

She opens her mouth slightly and rapidly waves her free hand back and forth directly in front of her mouth, trying to cool the food.

SHARED LAUGHTER: While fanning her mouth, she turns toward the vendor and makes eye contact. Her surprise becomes a spontaneous, slightly embarrassed laugh.
The vendor laughs warmly with her and gives a knowing nod. She responds with another genuine smile.

Both characters are reacting to each other, not independently performing for the camera.

CAMERA: Brief food detail → medium shot of her taking the bite → sustained medium two-shot showing her fanning gesture and shared laughter with the vendor.

Hold the two-shot approximately two seconds. Both faces remain visible. No cutaway during their shared laughter.

SCENE 05 | 0:25–0:30 | Osaka Street Portrait and Exit

Hard cut to another attractive pedestrian street in Osaka's Amerikamura/Shinsaibashi area.

Contemporary storefronts, elegant urban architecture, selective colorful signs, subtle reflections, and naturally spaced pedestrians.

0:25–0:27 | SIDE-PROFILE WALK

Beautiful cinematic side-tracking shot of the protagonist walking naturally along the sidewalk.

Her posture is graceful and confident, shoulders relaxed, movements fluid, walking rhythm effortless.

She appears radiant in the soft late-afternoon light. A subtle breeze moves loose strands of her dark hair.

She looks ahead with calm curiosity, comfortable in her surroundings. Her beauty comes through naturally, without exaggerated posing.

Camera tracks parallel to her at a natural walking speed, framing from approximately mid-thigh upward.

Clean composition, beautiful subject separation, sophisticated street-fashion editorial aesthetic.
No posing, stopping, or looking at the camera.

0:27–0:30 | FINAL CAMERA EXIT

Hard cut to a frontal medium shot.

The protagonist walks naturally toward the camera along the sidewalk.

Her expression is relaxed and quietly content.
As she approaches, she makes brief eye contact with the lens. A warm, subtle smile emerges naturally, softening her eyes.

CRITICAL ENDING ACTION: She continues forward, passes closely to the LEFT side of the camera, and exits the frame completely.

The camera remains stationary as she passes. Her shoulder briefly crosses the left edge of the frame.

Hold the street background for the final fraction of a second.

Do not stop her, freeze on her face, turn her around, or fade out before she exits.

GLOBAL PRODUCTION RULES

DURATION: Exactly 30 seconds, five scenes, approximately 12–16 purposeful shots. No unnecessary inserts, repeated reactions, or extended posing.

ASPECT RATIO: 3:4 portrait throughout. No letterboxing.

LANGUAGE: All characters speak natural, conversational English. Japanese characters may have subtle, authentic Japanese accents while speaking English. No Japanese dialogue, dubbing, translated speech, or dialogue subtitles.
OPENING TITLE: "Osaka, Japan" only. Horizontally and vertically centered. Large white Poppins Semi-Bold inside a compact rounded translucent charcoal rectangle (#17212B, 60% opacity). Visible 0:00–0:02 only.

ON-SCREEN TEXT: No dialogue subtitles, additional titles, captions, or logos. Only the opening location title. No gibberish signage or invented readable text.

AUDIO: Authentic Osaka street ambience, shop conversations, footsteps, takoyaki cooking, genuine laughter, and one photographer shutter click. No continuous soundtrack.

CINEMATOGRAPHY: Hyper-realistic live-action, visible pores, realistic facial detail, natural skin texture, believable lighting, accurate anatomy, realistic hair and fabric physics. Crisp focus, subtle background separation, restrained handheld movement, and balanced editorial compositions.

COLOR: Natural late-afternoon exterior tones. Controlled pastel pink, cyan, and metallic accents inside the Y2K boutique. No excessive saturation or yellow-brown grading.

EDITING: Hard cuts between scenes. The one-second photographic freeze-frame is the only intentional still image. No dissolves, slow motion, speed ramps, random inserts, or repeated angles.

CONTINUITY: Preserve the protagonist's exact face, hairstyle, outfit, accessories, and natural appearance throughout. No unexplained wardrobe changes.

ENVIRONMENT: Authentic Osaka architecture, contemporary Japanese storefronts, realistic pedestrians, and believable street activity. Stay on sidewalks and designated crossings.

PERFORMANCE: Quiet feminine confidence, grace, warmth, and worldly sophistication. Natural posture, fluid movement, expressive eyes, subtle gestures, genuine laughter, and emotionally motivated reactions. Never rigid, cold, robotic, or theatrical.

PRIORITIES: Correct centered opening title and charcoal backdrop; attractive colorful Y2K boutique; front-facing women's top; natural photographer conversation; ONE photograph with a one-second still portrait, eyes open and warm smile; genuine shared laughter with the takoyaki vendor; graceful side-profile walk; final smile and complete camera-left exit.

FINAL RESULT: A sophisticated, visually beautiful, emotionally engaging 30-second Osaka city tour. The protagonist is graceful, confident, charming, and genuinely relatable. Authentic street culture, warm human interactions, and understated cinematic elegance.

Photorealistic Hollywood-style zombie horror-action short film, opens with an instant attack, no slow build, grounded practical-effects style, maximum dynamic camera work. Setting: a lonely highway gas station and convenience store at 2 a.m., buzzing fluorescent canopy lights, wet asphalt, fuel pumps, a glass-fronted shop with a roll-down shutter, dark empty highway and fog beyond. No real brands or logos. CHARACTER LOCK: the hero is a night-shift attendant in his late 20s, short dark hair, navy work jacket over a gray t-shirt, jeans, boots, identical in every shot. The infected are pale, glazed-eyed, fast and erratic. Cold blue night tones against sickly green-white canopy light, natural diegetic sound, low pulsing score from the first frame. No gore, no blood. No text overlay, no watermark.
>
> **[0-1s]** Hard cut: a trucker at pump 3 suddenly lunges across the hood of a car and tackles a driver to the wet asphalt.
> **[1-2s]** Low-angle shot: a dropped fuel nozzle clatters across the ground as the nearby customers scream and scatter.
> **[2-3s]** Close-up: the two figures rise together, skin pale, eyes glazed, heads snapping toward the shop.
> **[3-4s]** Overhead security-camera angle: customers sprint for their cars, doors slamming, engines revving.
> **[4-5s]** Tracking shot: a minivan reverses wildly and clips a pump, and two more figures swarm out of the dark fog.
> **[5-6s]** Whip-pan: a woman trips at the shop door and the infected reach her as the shot cuts away.
> **[6-7s]** Wide shot: the forecourt is chaos, abandoned cars with doors open, a horn blaring, six infected moving between the pumps.
> **[7-8s]** Inside the shop, close-up: the hero stands frozen behind the counter, coffee spilling from his hand.
> **[8-9s]** Handheld: he slams the shop door lock and hits the shutter button, the metal shutter rattling halfway down.
> **[9-10s]** Low-angle shot: the shutter jams on a toppled stand and a pale hand clutches the gap.
> **[10-11s]** Close-up: he grabs a heavy tire iron from beneath the counter and braces.
> **[11-12s]** Wide shot: three infected crawl under the shutter into the shop, knocking snack racks across the floor.
> **[12-13s]** Handheld: he swings the tire iron and drops the first, which slams into a shelf and goes still.
> **[13-14s]** Side-tracking shot: he vaults the counter and drives the second back into a glass drinks fridge, the door cracking.
> **[14-15s]** Low-angle shot: the third lunges and he sidesteps, catching it with the iron and dropping it to the tiles.
> **[15-16s]** Wide shot: the shop is quiet for one beat, flickering lights, the shutter still half open.
> **[16-17s]** Close-up: he looks through the window at the forecourt, where five more infected turn toward him.
> **[17-18s]** Overhead shot: a tow truck with a heavy winch cable sits idle by the car wash bay, keys dangling.
> **[18-19s]** He kicks the shutter up and sprints across the wet forecourt toward the tow truck.
> **[19-20s]** Tracking shot: infected chase him between the pumps, splashing through puddles.
> **[20-21s]** Close-up: he leaps into the cab, slams the door and cranks the ignition.
> **[21-22s]** Low-angle shot: the tow truck roars forward and bulldozes through the first pack of infected at the pumps.
> **[22-23s]** Wide shot: the cable swings and sweeps three more off their feet across the asphalt.
> **[23-24s]** Close-up: he brakes hard, jumps out and grabs the tire iron again as two final infected charge.
> **[24-25s]** SLOW MOTION: he spins, striking the first one down, then pivots as the second lunges.
> **[25-26s]** SLOW MOTION: one last clean swing and the final infected collapses and goes still.
> **[26-27s]** Real-time wide shot: bodies still across the forecourt, a single pump nozzle swinging in the wind, silence.
> **[27-28s]** Close-up: his chest heaves, sweat and rain on his face, the tire iron lowered.
> **[28-29s]** Wide shot: he scans the fog-covered highway and the empty road.
> **[29-30s]** Final shot: he sits down on the tow truck bumper under the buzzing canopy light as dawn breaks over the highway and sirens rise in the distance. Cut to black.
>
> Audio: buzzing fluorescent lights, rain on the canopy, glass and metal impacts, screaming, engines and a stuck car horn, heavy breathing, distant sirens at the end, layered with a low pulsing score that drops to silence for the slow-motion strikes. Camera: low angles, overhead security-cam shots, whip pans, tracking, handheld close-ups, slow motion only on the final two kills. Realistic shake only on impacts.

Created on @SocialSight

以提供的人物参考图为基础，保持人物原有的面部特征、五官比例及整体气质，生成一段超高清、电影级写实风格的日系街头生活短片。

场景设定在阳光明媚的清晨，充满生活气息的日本街道上。街道两侧分布着各式各样的小店，招牌与建筑错落有致，远处不时有骑自行车的行人和缓慢经过的车辆，营造真实自然的城市日常氛围。

人物站在路边安全区域内，一头柔顺的黑色长发自然披散。微风轻轻吹动发梢，几缕发丝随风掠过脸颊。温暖的晨光从侧前方洒落，照亮人物的面部轮廓与发丝，形成柔和通透的自然光晕。

人物拥有精致协调的五官、挺拔的鼻梁、自然细腻的肌肤，整体散发清纯温柔、略带慵懒的学姐气质。单肩背着一只黑色高级质感皮包，双手随意握着手机，身体姿态舒展放松。

镜头以手持街拍的方式缓缓靠近，伴随轻微自然晃动。人物先低头看手机，随后被街边的声音吸引，轻轻抬头，目光不经意间与镜头交汇，露出自然放松的神情。整个过程没有刻意摆拍的感觉。

微风吹过街道，几片梧桐树叶缓缓飘落。背景中的行人、车辆与树影自然运动，建筑表面呈现真实细腻的光影变化。

画面采用清新日系胶片快照色调，明亮通透，色彩柔和，保留真实皮肤纹理与自然光线层次。构图略带随性与不规则感，模拟摄影师在街头偶然捕捉到的生活瞬间。

4K 超高清画质，24fps，真实物理光照，自然景深，细腻动态表现，人物面部高度一致，动作流畅连贯，无明显 AI 生成痕迹。

负面提示词： 过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、夸张美颜、五官变形、人物换脸、手指畸形、肢体扭曲、头发穿模、背景闪烁、车辆变形、动作僵硬、镜头剧烈抖动、过度锐化、虚假光影、卡通质感、CG 渲染感。

Prompt:

Shot on Mamiya RB67, Sekor 127mm f/3.8 lens, f/8, Kodak Portra 160 film, soft frontal studio flash with umbrella, scanned film look. Deadpan seated portrait of a lanky man in his thirties with a mustache and side-parted hair, wearing a pale mint short-sleeve button-up shirt and khaki shorts, legs crossed showing long coral ribbed socks with mustard toes and heels, holding a folded pair of the same socks on his lap like an award, wrapped in a cream paper band printed "TOETOE" and "ribbed cotton socks". Background: hand-painted mottled rust-brown and sand canvas studio backdrop like an old school portrait. Faded film look: lifted blacks, slightly washed colors, warm yellowish cast, soft contrast, fine film grain. Mood: awkward, nostalgic, dry humor. p:
SEEDANCE 2.5 DIRECTOR PROMPT

Duration：30秒
Aspect ratio：16:9横屏

Reference / SUBJECT：
@图片1＝女主，锁定面部身份、发型、肤色和体型。
@图片2＝男主，锁定面部身份、发型、肤色和体型。
两人均为成年年轻人。参考图负责人物身份，服装统一替换为下方造型。以下正文只使用“女主”“男主”指代。

影片基调
似曾相识的海边初遇，发展成温柔明亮的爱情。
前23秒讲述骑车下坡的女主与迎面步行的男主擦肩，两人都感到一种难以解释的熟悉，先后回头。男主轻声问“我们是不是在哪里见过？”，女主由惊讶转为浅浅的微笑。
后7秒通过三个蒙太奇镜头，展现后来两人牵手、拥抱、接吻的幸福片段。对白、表情与剪辑共同服务这条感情线。

OVERALL STYLE
真人日系青春爱情电影，具有新海诚影片中通透明亮的夏日光影气质。
湛蓝天空、层次丰富的白色积云、碧蓝海湾、海面碎光、浓绿山坡、沿海小镇屋顶、电线杆与白色道路护栏。
真实演员、自然肤色、细腻衣料与实景摄影。阳光照亮发丝，阴影保留层次。前段清爽明亮，后段过渡到温暖夕阳，人物始终保持真人质感。

WARDROBE
女主：米白色轻薄短袖衬衫，领口系细窄酒红丝带，雾蓝色高腰及膝A字半裙，深棕色系带短靴。清爽自然，丝带与裙摆随风轻动。
男主：米白色轻薄衬衫敞开穿，浅灰蓝色圆领内搭，炭灰色直筒长裤，棕色短靴，浅卡其色帆布双肩包。
全片保持这两套造型，色彩相互呼应，无校徽、品牌标志或大面积文字。

GLOBAL CONTINUITY
前23秒始终位于同一条海边坡道。上坡方向是绿山，下坡方向是小镇、港口与海湾。
女主骑红色城市自行车，有银色前车筐和后货架，深色背包固定在后货架上。车轮、车架、背包位置保持一致。
男主迎着女主步行上坡。擦肩后，男主位于女主后方的上坡处，女主位于下坡处。
23秒后明确剪辑到相恋后的生活片段，用场景、光线和亲密程度表达时间流逝，不在同一镜头内瞬间改变两人的关系。

AUDIO / DIALOGUE
空灵的无词人声、轻柔钢琴与弦乐组成电影配乐，保留少量海风、自行车轮声和脚步声。对白时降低配乐，后7秒音乐舒展上扬。

约17.3秒，男主从女主身后轻声叫她：
「ねえ。」
语气轻柔，像想确认什么，女主听见后才回头。

约20–22.5秒，男主看着女主，自然说：
「どこかで、会ったことある？」
中文含义：我们是不是在哪里见过？
“どこかで”之后有一个很短的迟疑，后半句轻轻问出。语气真诚、好奇，带着似曾相识的感觉。声音平稳，不油腔滑调，不夸张挑眉。
由男主说出，口型准确对应日语。女主不回答，以眼神和微笑回应。

无其他对白、旁白、内心独白、歌词、字幕或片名文字。

CAMERA AND EDITING
采用电影分镜剪辑，使用硬切（Hard cut）、视线匹配剪辑（Eyeline match）和动作衔接。
前段交替呈现车轮细节、骑行全景、海湾远景、人物近景与擦肩全景。让观众看清人物发现彼此、经过、回头的顺序。
侧面擦肩镜头里，女主由左向右骑行，男主由右向左步行。
后7秒是三个独立的恋爱蒙太奇镜头，每个镜头完成一个清楚的互动，切镜表达时间流逝。

SHOT TIMELINE

[00–01秒｜车轮与鞋履]
贴地低机位细节特写（Low-angle detail close-up）。
红色自行车前轮向前滚动，银色辐条闪过阳光，女主棕色短靴短暂进入画面。
摄影机低位跟拍（Low tracking shot），沥青纹理向后移动，轮胎始终接触地面。

[01–02秒｜自由开心地滑行]
硬切迎面全身全景（Frontal full shot），摄影机在女主前方平稳后退（Tracking backward）。
女主坐在车座上，双手握住车把，让自行车顺坡滑行；双脚离开踏板向两侧自然展开，脸上是放松明亮的笑容。
身体坐稳，丝带、头发与裙摆被风轻轻带起。

[02–04秒｜海湾展开]
切坡顶背面大远景（Rear extreme wide shot）。
女主骑车向坡下远去，双腿展开的姿态承接前镜。白色护栏沿坡道向下延伸，海湾、小镇屋顶与远处海岸逐渐铺满画面。
摄影机基本稳定，人物逐渐变小，海面闪着细碎阳光。

[04–06秒｜第一次注意到他]
切女主迎面特写（Close-up），摄影机与自行车同速后退。
她起初仍在笑，随后看见前方的男主，笑意慢慢收住，视线停留，眼睛略微睁大，嘴唇轻轻分开。
表情是被某种熟悉感吸引，带一点好奇与心动。变化自然连续。
女主逐渐收回双腿，恢复正常控车姿态。

[06–08秒｜男主迎面走来]
切女主视线方向的全身远景（Full shot）。
男主沿坡道向上走，背后是海湾、港口与小镇。步伐从容，帆布包随身体轻摆。
摄影机缓慢推进（Slow push-in），保留道路、护栏与海湾的纵深关系。

[08–09秒｜男主的目光]
切男主胸像近景（Medium close-up）。
男主继续前行，目光短暂落向前方的女主，眼神中出现很轻的注意与停顿。
海风带动发丝和敞开的衬衫衣角，肩上背包带保持稳定。表情克制自然，不提前露出夸张笑容。

[09–12秒｜擦肩而过]
切道路侧面全景（Side-on wide shot），两人的全身与自行车都能看见。
女主从画面左侧向右骑行，男主从右侧向左步行，相向接近，在道路中央保持正常距离擦肩经过，再向各自方向分开。
女主双手握把，男主正常迈步，没有碰撞或拉扯。
蓝天、海面与白色护栏构成干净背景，人物影子在路面连续移动。

[12–13秒｜男主先回头]
切男主侧后近景（Rear three-quarter medium close-up）。
女主骑行的身影从近处前景掠过。男主脚步放慢，像突然想起什么，转头看向她离开的方向。
逆光照亮发丝，出现短暂自然镜头炫光（Lens flare）。摄影机小幅跟随转头。

[13–15秒｜女主也感到熟悉]
切女主眼睛与面部的近距离特写，迅速但平顺地拉开到胸像（Close-up to medium close-up / Pull-back）。
女主眼睛略微睁大，神情有短暂失神，像在回想刚才那个人。随后目光重新集中，开始减速。
拉开后露出上坡道路，男主位于远处背景。面部比例真实，保留微妙表情，避免夸张瞪眼。

[15–19秒｜听到呼唤，回头寻找]
切女主背面中景（Rear medium shot），海湾在她前方。
女主握住刹车使自行车停稳，一只脚落地支撑，身体仍朝下坡方向。停顿片刻。
约17.3秒，身后响起男主轻声的「ねえ。」
女主听见后，先移动目光，再从右肩上方回头，肩膀小幅跟随，发丝顺着转头轻摆。
手仍扶着车把，自行车保持原方向。完整呈现“听见—回头—找到他”的动作链。

[19–23秒｜一句似曾相识的问话]
视线匹配切到女主肩侧的过肩镜头（Over-the-shoulder shot）。
女主肩部与侧脸占画面右侧前景，男主站在上坡方向的中远处，两人隔着一段道路距离对视。
男主轻轻停顿，约20秒开始问：
「どこかで、会ったことある？」
他说话时目光一直落在女主身上，表情真诚，像真的在确认一段模糊的记忆。
约22.5秒说完后，切女主短促的反应近景（Reaction close-up）：她眼里的惊讶慢慢松开，嘴角出现一丝浅笑，仍看着男主。
用这一个微笑连接后面的恋爱蒙太奇，女主不添加口头回答。

[23–25秒｜新增蒙太奇一：后来牵着手]
随音乐节拍硬切到相恋后的明亮午后，海边步道双人中景（Two-shot / Medium shot）。
两人已经牵着靠近彼此的那只手，并肩向前走。女主侧头看男主，男主回应她的目光，两人自然笑起来。
摄影机在前侧方平稳跟拍（Tracking shot），脸和牵着的手同时清楚。红色自行车停在后方栏杆旁，海面碎光闪烁。
这是后来相处的幸福片段，以明确剪辑表达时间跳跃。

[25–27秒｜新增蒙太奇二：主动拥抱]
硬切夕阳下的海边观景处，双人侧面中景（Side two-shot）。
男主站稳，女主笑着靠近一步，主动环抱他的腰背。男主自然张开双臂，一只手轻扶她上背，另一只手环住腰侧，温柔回抱。
身体先靠近，再形成拥抱。手臂前后层次清楚，衣料产生自然褶皱。
女主把脸轻靠在男主肩侧，男主低头微笑。摄影机轻轻推近（Gentle push-in），夕阳形成温暖轮廓光。

[27–30秒｜新增蒙太奇三：短吻与微笑]
切同一夕阳场景的双人侧面近景（Profile two-shot / Close-up）。
两人稍微松开拥抱，仍轻扶彼此，抬眼对视。女主轻轻抬头靠近，男主微微俯身回应，双方自然闭眼，完成一次短暂温柔的嘴唇轻吻。
接触后稍微分开，距离仍近，重新看着彼此，露出轻松幸福的笑容。
摄影机缓慢小幅推进（Slow push-in），保留两个人完整的侧脸轮廓，不快速环绕。
最后半秒停留在相视微笑、轻微呼吸与海风吹动的发丝上，金色海面柔和虚化，音乐自然舒展。

CONTINUITY
人物身份、两套服装、红色自行车和背包保持一致。
前23秒的熟悉感通过目光、停顿、回头和问话逐渐建立。
后7秒只安排牵手、拥抱、短吻三个互动，双方主动回应，动作柔和自然。
对白结束后的女主微笑，是初遇段与恋爱段的情绪连接点。
后段是时间跳跃的蒙太奇，不让远处的男主在同一镜头内瞬移到女主身边。

NEGATIVE

服装漂移，背包消失，道具增殖
自行车悬浮，车轮倒转，车架变形
擦肩方向颠倒，身体穿车，空间跳轴
提前回头，女主代说男主台词
废墟问话，中文配音，新增对白
夸张瞪眼，油腻挑眉，僵硬摆拍
拥抱穿模，多余手臂，脸部融合
突然撞脸，强拉亲吻，亲吻后表情冻结
闪白转场，场景融化，人物瞬移
